item.isekai_mahou.mage_staff_t1.desc: Plain oak and a blue crystal: every student's first focus.
item.isekai_mahou.mage_staff_t2.desc: Walnut ringed in gold; the arcane crystal hums softly.
item.isekai_mahou.mage_staff_t3.desc: Runic ebony and a silver frame cradling crystal moons.
item.isekai_mahou.mage_staff_t4.desc: Ivory and gold, a halo of stars: the mark of a true master.
item.isekai_mahou.witch_wand_t1.desc: Birch from the witches' grove, tipped with an amethyst shard.
item.isekai_mahou.witch_wand_t2.desc: Cherry wood and silver: it shines brighter under the moon.
item.isekai_mahou.witch_wand_t3.desc: A shadow disc swallows the light; its violet runes never sleep.
item.isekai_mahou.witch_wand_t4.desc: Obsidian, gold and a crystal heart that beats with old curses.
item.isekai_mahou.pact_blade_t1.desc: Darkened steel sealed with a drop of blood.
item.isekai_mahou.pact_blade_t2.desc: The horned guard remembers who made the pact.
item.isekai_mahou.pact_blade_t3.desc: Forged in the heat of the abyss; the eye on the guard never blinks.
item.isekai_mahou.pact_blade_t4.desc: A pact sovereign's blade: it thirsts, and it is always sated.
item.isekai_mahou.druid_staff_t1.desc: A young branch that still sprouts leaves in your hand.
item.isekai_mahou.druid_staff_t2.desc: It blooms in spring, and wherever there is magic.
item.isekai_mahou.druid_staff_t3.desc: Moss, amber and green runes: the whole grove whispers through it.
item.isekai_mahou.druid_staff_t4.desc: Cut with the Mother Tree's blessing; golden leaves and a sun at its heart.
item.isekai_mahou.reaper_scythe_t1.desc: A gravedigger's tool that learned to reap something else.
item.isekai_mahou.reaper_scythe_t2.desc: A spine for a handle and a guardian's skull.
item.isekai_mahou.reaper_scythe_t3.desc: The skull's eyes follow souls that have not yet departed.
item.isekai_mahou.reaper_scythe_t4.desc: Crowned in silver, it reaps two souls where others reap one.
item.isekai_mahou.vitality_charm.desc: A ruby heart that beats along with yours: +4 hearts.
item.isekai_mahou.ward_ring.desc: A barrier as thin as a veil surrounds its wearer.
item.isekai_mahou.archmage_sigil.desc: The seal of the great mages: all your spells grow stronger.
item.isekai_mahou.arcane_upgrade_templat: Next tier's material (see the item's tooltip)
Add an Arsenal weapon or a class outfit piece
Weapons: II Mana Crystal Block · III Arcane Diamond · IV Guardian Core
item.isekai_mahou.arcane_diamond.desc: Arcane Upgrade material: takes an Arsenal weapon from tier II to III.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.reaper_scyth: Melee kills reap souls into your Phylactery
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.mage_staff.p: 10% chance to refund all the mana of each spell.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.witch_wand.p: Spell hits leave the target Corrupted II for 5 s (damage over time).
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.pact_blade.p: Strikes steal 25% of the damage as health (up to 5 hearts).
Every 2 s heals one heart to you and allies within 6 blocks.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.reaper_scyth: Each kill reaps an extra soul; without a Phylactery it becomes 18 mana.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.upgrade_hint: Upgrade at a Smithing Table: Arcane Template + %s
message.isekai_mahou.armory.catch_up: ✦ The Arsenal delivered the rewards for the levels you had already reached!
message.isekai_mahou.armory.kit: ✦ Level %s reward: you already had %s, so you got an Upgrade Kit: %s
item.isekai_mahou.longsword_t1.desc: Plain steel and a long grip: the sword of anyone starting down the warrior's road.
item.isekai_mahou.longsword_t2.desc: A golden guard and a red gem: it bears the marks of a hundred duels.
item.isekai_mahou.longsword_t3.desc: Ember runes run down the fuller; the blade never fully cools.
item.isekai_mahou.longsword_t4.desc: Living flames rise from the winged guard: the sword of the heroes in the songs.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.longsword.tr: Full strikes sweep nearby enemies, like a sword.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.longsword.pa: Full strikes build Momentum (up to 3, fades after 4 s); at 3, your next full strike deals +60% and unleashes a fire slash.
item.isekai_mahou.holy_mace_t1.desc: Iron and oak blessed at the village temple.
item.isekai_mahou.holy_mace_t2.desc: Consecrated silver with the sun's symbol on each face.
item.isekai_mahou.holy_mace_t3.desc: White gold and golden runes: the undead flee from its glow.
item.isekai_mahou.holy_mace_t4.desc: A halo of light turns behind the head: the sun never sets for whoever wields it.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.holy_mace.tr: +25% damage against the undead; hits on them raise a pillar of light.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.holy_mace.pa: The bonus against undead becomes +50%, and full strikes heal you and allies within 6 blocks (at most once every 2 s).
item.isekai_mahou.greataxe_t1.desc: Heavy, simple and honest: it settles any argument.
item.isekai_mahou.greataxe_t2.desc: A bone haft and beast fur; the skull on the socket still growls.
item.isekai_mahou.greataxe_t3.desc: Two obsidian blades etched with blood runes.
item.isekai_mahou.greataxe_t4.desc: The edge burns like embers and the skull's eyes blaze with your fury.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.greataxe.tra: Like an axe, a strike knocks down the guard of anyone blocking with a shield.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.greataxe.pas: +1% damage for every 2% of health you have lost (up to +45%).
item.isekai_mahou.ki_gauntlets_t1.desc: Cloth wraps and leather: the first step on the way of the fist.
item.isekai_mahou.ki_gauntlets_t2.desc: Bronze and a jade stone that holds the monk's breath.
item.isekai_mahou.ki_gauntlets_t3.desc: Silver plates with tide runes: every punch flows like water.
item.isekai_mahou.ki_gauntlets_t4.desc: Rings of bright ki and golden fins: the wind obeys your fists.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.ki_gauntlets: Quick punches and light steps: more attack and movement speed. With your other hand empty, you wear both gauntlets.
Every 4 full strikes in a row, a ki wave damages (7.5) and pushes back the enemies around your target.
item.isekai_mahou.knight_blade_t1.desc: The first sword of one who swore to protect others.
item.isekai_mahou.knight_blade_t2.desc: Silver and blue leather, with the order's crest on the pommel.
item.isekai_mahou.knight_blade_t3.desc: Bluish steel and the golden runes of the king's guard.
item.isekai_mahou.knight_blade_t4.desc: Golden wings and a fuller of light: no wall falls while it stands.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.knight_blade: Armor and footing against knockback; made to fight with the Knight's Shield.
Blocking a hit with a shield returns 40% of the blocked damage to the attacker and grants Absorption.
item.isekai_mahou.longbow_t1.desc: Fire-bent yew and a linen string.
item.isekai_mahou.longbow_t2.desc: Bone tips and the green gem of the forest wardens.
item.isekai_mahou.longbow_t3.desc: Elven wood with runes that whisper the wind's direction.
item.isekai_mahou.longbow_t4.desc: The string is made of wind; its arrows never miss what the hawk's eye sees.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.longbow.trai: Longer draw and stronger zoom; much faster, stronger arrows. A full draw releases with a gust of wind.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.longbow.pass: Fully drawn shots deal +25% at 12+ blocks and +50% at 24+ blocks.
item.isekai_mahou.twin_daggers_t1.desc: Two short blades: one distracts, the other settles it.
item.isekai_mahou.twin_daggers_t2.desc: Darkened so they never shine at night.
item.isekai_mahou.twin_daggers_t3.desc: Serrated and edged with violet runes.
item.isekai_mahou.twin_daggers_t4.desc: Forged during an eclipse; their shadow cuts before the blade.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.twin_daggers: Full strikes hit again with the other dagger (35% damage). With your other hand empty, you wield both.
The double strike poisons (Poison II for 3 s) and strikes from behind deal +40%.
item.isekai_mahou.lute_t1.desc: Pine, gut strings and goodwill: it plays the tavern songs.
item.isekai_mahou.lute_t2.desc: Maple and gold; the minstrel swears it tunes itself.
item.isekai_mahou.lute_t3.desc: Ebony with runes that light up with every chord.
item.isekai_mahou.lute_t4.desc: Ivory, gold and strings of light: its song heals and gives courage.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.lute.trait.d: Hold right-click to play: +1 Focus per second, and it counts as the Bard's spellcasting focus.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.lute.passive: While playing, every 2 s you and allies within 8 blocks gain Regeneration I and Speed I.
item.isekai_mahou.arcane_crossbow_t1.des: Brass and rosewood assembled on an apprentice artificer's bench.
item.isekai_mahou.arcane_crossbow_t2.des: An arcane gear tensions the string in an instant.
item.isekai_mahou.arcane_crossbow_t3.des: Violet runes guide the bolts; the string glows with mana.
item.isekai_mahou.arcane_crossbow_t4.des: The artificer's grand engine: every bolt is a small spell.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.arcane_cross: Loads faster and bolt damage is multiplied by your Spell Power (up to ×2).
Bolts burst on impact: 7.5 damage to enemies within 2.5 blocks, without breaking blocks.
item.isekai_mahou.hunter_crossbow_t1.des: Sturdy and reliable, made for long hunts.
item.isekai_mahou.hunter_crossbow_t2.des: Wolf fur on the stock and an iron prod that never gives.
item.isekai_mahou.hunter_crossbow_t3.des: Bone and steel: its bolts drop even bears.
item.isekai_mahou.hunter_crossbow_t4.des: The ember sight never loses the marked prey.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.hunter_cross: Stronger bolts that leave the target Slowed I for 2 s.
The target glows for 8 s and takes +25% damage from you and your creatures.
item.isekai_mahou.knight_shield.desc: Blue steel and the order's sun: steady as a wall.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.knight_shiel: Blocking a melee hit pushes the attacker back. In the off hand: +3 armor and +1.5 toughness.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.armory.generic_weap: Standalone weapon (%s) — any class can use it
